at_least_one_vehicle_event_on_first_stop.description: A ride must have at least one event at the first stop.
at_least_one_vehicle_event_on_first_stop.label: At least one event at the first stop

at_least_one_vehicle_event_on_last_stop.description: A ride must end at the last stop.
at_least_one_vehicle_event_on_last_stop.label: Ended at the last stop

expected_apex_validation_interval.description: The interval between validations is organic and reflects the natural variation in passenger validation times.
expected_apex_validation_interval.label: APEX validation interval

expected_driver_id_qty.description: A ride may have no more than two different driver IDs.
expected_driver_id_qty.label: No more than two drivers

expected_start_time.description: A ride must start after the planned time and less than 5 minutes late.
expected_start_time.label: On-time start

expected_vehicle_event_coverage_geo.description: At least 90% of the stops on the route must have at least one GPS position.
expected_vehicle_event_coverage_geo.label: Stops Served (90%)

expected_vehicle_event_delay.description: Events must be delivered within 10 seconds of being generated.
expected_vehicle_event_delay.label: Excessive event delivery delay

expected_vehicle_event_interval.description: The average interval between events must not exceed 20 seconds.
expected_vehicle_event_interval.label: Average interval between events

expected_vehicle_event_qty.description: A ride must have at least 10 vehicle events.
expected_vehicle_event_qty.label: Fewer than 10 vehicle events

expected_vehicle_id_qty.description: A ride may have no more than two different vehicle IDs.
expected_vehicle_id_qty.label: No more than two vehicles

matching_apex_locations.description: Location transactions must match vehicle events.
matching_apex_locations.label: Matching location transactions

matching_vehicle_ids.description: Vehicle IDs received in events must match the IDs in APEX transactions.
matching_vehicle_ids.label: Matching vehicle IDs

simple_one_apex_validation.description: A ride must have at least one validation transaction.
simple_one_apex_validation.label: At least one validation transaction

simple_one_vehicle_event_or_apex_validat.description: A ride must have at least one event or validation transaction.
simple_one_vehicle_event_or_apex_validat.label: At least one event or validation transaction

simple_three_vehicle_events.description: A ride must have at least three events, at the beginning, middle and end of the trip.
simple_three_vehicle_events.label: At least three events

transaction_sequentiality.description: All transactions generated by the validator were delivered.
transaction_sequentiality.label: APEX Transaction Sequentiality
